pages.title: Transfer Exception
pages.text: $(bold)ORSA CAMP TRANSFER LOG$()$(br)Filed by: Acting Camp Lead$(br2)Assigned civilian transfer personnel from a nearby monitoring station did not report by the end of the weather window.$(br2)Terminal directive acknowledged. Arrival never confirmed.

pages.title: No Contact
pages.text: No visual contact on the south approach. No second pickup dispatched. Radio response from the transfer party ended before camp-side confirmation.$(br2)The staff were marked delayed, then nonresponsive, because there was no category for what came after.
